.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -c 'import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from app.extraction.knowledge_merge import CATEGORIES, normalize_knowledge_ids, validate_provenance
from app.models.knowledge import KnowledgeDocument
from app.models.source import SourceDocument

assert Path(sys.prefix).resolve() == Path(''.venv'').resolve(), ''Wrong interpreter''
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
source = root / ''data/output/complete_e2e_validation/validation_20261101_174430/knowledge_corrected_v2.json''
source_units = source.parent / ''source_units.json''
original_bytes = source.read_bytes()
original_sha = hashlib.sha256(original_bytes).hexdigest()
raw = json.loads(original_bytes)
knowledge = KnowledgeDocument.model_validate(raw)
result = normalize_knowledge_ids(knowledge, artifact_id=source.as_posix())
after = result.document.model_dump(mode=''json'')
changes = []
before_snapshot = []
for category in CATEGORIES:
    assert len(raw[category]) == len(after[category])
    for index, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(raw[category], after[category])):
        old_payload, new_payload = dict(old), dict(new)
        old_id, new_id = old_payload.pop(''knowledge_id''), new_payload.pop(''knowledge_id'')
        assert old_payload == new_payload, (category, index)
        before_snapshot.append({''category'': category, ''item_index'': index, ''knowledge_id'': old_id,
                                ''non_id_fields'': old_payload})
        if old_id != new_id:
            changes.append({''category'': category, ''item_index'': index, ''old_id'': old_id, ''new_id'': new_id})
assert {k:v for k,v in raw.items() if k not in CATEGORIES} == {k:v for k,v in after.items() if k not in CATEGORIES}
assert result.preservation.passed
assert result.preservation.before_count == result.preservation.after_count == 473
assert result.preservation.before_unique_ids == 466
assert result.preservation.after_unique_ids == 473
assert len(changes) == result.preservation.reassigned_count == 7
evidence = SourceDocument.model_validate_json(source_units.read_text(encoding=''utf-8''))
provenance = validate_provenance(result.document, evidence)
assert provenance.valid, provenance.errors
assert source.read_bytes() == original_bytes

stamp = datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))).strftime(''%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f'')
out = root / ''data/output'' / (''knowledge_normalization_'' + stamp)
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def save(name, data):
    with (out / name).open(''x'', encoding=''utf-8'') as stream:
        json.dump(data, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
(out / ''knowledge_before.json'').write_bytes(original_bytes)
save(''preservation_before.json'', {''original_path'': source.as_posix(), ''original_sha256'': original_sha,
                                 ''item_count'': len(before_snapshot), ''items'': before_snapshot})
save(''knowledge_normalized.json'', after)
save(''id_mappings.json'', [entry.model_dump(mode=''json'') for entry in result.mappings])
save(''preservation_report.json'', {
    **result.preservation.model_dump(mode=''json''),
    ''raw_json_item_fields_equal'': True,
    ''raw_json_document_metadata_equal'': True,
    ''original_sha256_before'': original_sha,
    ''original_sha256_after'': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    ''original_bytes_unchanged'': source.read_bytes() == original_bytes,
    ''changed_items'': changes,
    ''dependent_reference_status'': ''Resolver tested; historical dependent artifacts untouched; regeneration pending'',
    ''provenance'': provenance.model_dump(mode=''json''),
})
diff = ''''
files = [''app/extraction/knowledge_merge.py'', ''tests/test_knowledge_merge.py'']
for name in files:
    diff += ''''.join(difflib.unified_diff([], (root/name).read_text(encoding=''utf-8'').splitlines(True),
                                        fromfile=''/dev/null'', tofile=''b/''+name))
(out / ''code_diff.patch'').write_text(diff, encoding=''utf-8'')
save(''execution_manifest.json'', {
    ''status'': ''NO-GO'', ''step'': ''Knowledge normalization only; no extraction or recovery'',
    ''python_executable'': sys.executable, ''python_version'': sys.version,
    ''input'': source.as_posix(), ''input_sha256'': original_sha,
    ''source_units'': source_units.as_posix(),
    ''source_units_sha256'': hashlib.sha256(source_units.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    ''code_sha256'': {name: hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files},
    ''test_command'': ''.\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_knowledge_merge.py tests/test_serialization.py'',
    ''tests'': {''passed'': 41, ''failed'': 0},
    ''execution_command'': [sys.executable, ''-B'', ''-c'', sys.argv[0] if len(sys.argv) else ''''],
})
assert source.read_bytes() == original_bytes
print(json.dumps({''artifact_directory'': str(out), ''original_sha256'': original_sha,
                  ''items'': 473, ''unique_ids'': 473, ''reassigned'': changes,
                  ''preservation_passed'': True, ''release'': ''NO-GO''}, indent=2))
'
